summary: The recorded base reproduces the issue-specific construction failure: both MoonViT RowParallelLinear sites are sharded by attn_tp_size but retain global-TP reduction when DP attention is enabled. At the exact candidate commit, both sites select the attention-TP reducer. The candidate regression passes, the full Kimi-VL unit file passes, and an independent forward-path test proves both affected projections call the expected communicator in DP-enabled and DP-disabled modes.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned host exposes one AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950. The original deadlock requires TP4/DP2 and the unavailable Kimi-VL weights. No unrelated single-GPU smoke was treated as original-issue proof. Evidence: raw/gpu-inventory.log

remaining_limitations: The original Kimi-VL TP4/DP2 HTTP serving deadlock was not reproduced end-to-end because only one GPU was assigned and Kimi-VL weights were unavailable.
The available architecture is AMD gfx950, not the NVIDIA H100 architecture in the original report.
The regression and independent harness verify construction and actual RowParallelLinear communicator dispatch, but cannot execute a real four-rank collective schedule on one GPU.
No model semantic-accuracy, full-model numerical, NVIDIA, or multi-node claim is made.
No native rebuild was needed because the candidate changes only Python and report files.
